task:
A fund holds 1892 credits. Its first grant is 18% of that original balance. Return 30% of this grant to the fund, so that portion is not spent. A second grant is 7% of the original balance minus 7 credits (the 7 credits are subtracted BEFORE taking the percentage). What is total spending after the returned portion? Give an exact answer. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 3 credits, then discount the whole amount by 19%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 13% surcharge, then subtract 19 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 13 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 12% surcharge, then subtract 20 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 16 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 5 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 27 credits, then discount the whole amount by 10%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 16 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 8 credits, then discount the whole amount by 10%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 5% surcharge, then subtract 23 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 5 credits, then discount the whole amount by 12%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 15% surcharge, then subtract 4 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 8 credits, then discount the whole amount by 11%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 12% surcharge, then subtract 14 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 9%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 18% surcharge, then subtract 22 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 9 credits, then discount the whole amount by 13%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 17 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 14 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
